mathematical_meanings: Left image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right end of the horizontal axis through the smooth graph). Right image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right arrow of the axis passing through the hyperbola center).
Rationales: In both images, x names the horizontal coordinate axis. The relevant locations are the right end of the horizontal axis through the smooth graph on the left and the right arrow of the axis passing through the hyperbola center on the right.
